children: Genmab reported Rina-S achieved a confirmed 45.9% ORR and 12.1-month mDOR in 109 platinum‑resistant ovarian cancer patients; mPFS was 9.5 months. Activity was seen regardless of FRα expression and prior mirvetuximab.

ORR 45.9% in 109 PROC patients
High response rate in a hard-to-treat setting can de-risk the asset and support Phase 3 and potential filing paths.
mDOR 12.1 months (95% CI 6.5–15.4)
Durability supports clinical value; over half remained in response at 1 year.
mPFS 9.5 months (95% CI 7.6–11.3)

Activity regardless of FRα level
Could expand addressable market beyond high FRα expressers, aiding revenue potential.
Prior mirvetuximab did not preclude ORR
Signals potential in post-mirvetuximab setting, increasing line-of-therapy utility.
No ocular or ILD safety signals
